# Dhanush Battu

> Dhanush Battu (also written Battu Dhanush) is a software engineer in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, who builds full-stack web, cross-platform mobile and machine-learning applications. He is studying for a B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at BMS Institute of Technology and Management (BMSIT), 2023–2027 (expected), and a B.Sc. in Mathematics for Data Science at IIT Madras (online). He is open to software development and AI/ML roles.

This is his official portfolio website, dhanushbattu.in. Everything below is stated by him.

## Experience

- Software Developer (Freelance), Elite IIT, Bengaluru: built a Meta-compliant WhatsApp Business API automation platform with a bilingual generative-AI assistant for localized marketing content, edtech-style visual generation workflows, campaign segmentation and prompt engineering.

## Projects

- [VeriAI](https://github.com/DhanushBattu/verification-ai-v2): B.E. major project (team of 4). An AI hallucination verification system that checks every claim in an AI answer against Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crossref and OpenAlex, flags wrong claims and catches fabricated papers and books. Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers.
- [Cross-platform Rental App](https://github.com/DhanushBattu/Rental_main): a marketplace for Web, iOS and Android built with Flutter, Dart and Firebase (Cloud Firestore, Cloud Messaging), with KYC flows, role-based access control and transaction-safe bookings.
- Cyber Café Management System: a full-stack web app (PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) for session tracking, computer allocation, billing and a live admin dashboard.
- [IPL Intelligence](https://github.com/DhanushBattu/IPL-Predictor-Analytics): analysis of 1,095 IPL matches (2008–2024) and a Flask web app that serves winner predictions from six machine-learning models. Python, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, SQLite.
